title: Groton Rhine St. Façade Repair — Worked Example (v2)
description:
v2 canonical worked example for the citizen-permitting flow. A
resident of Groton, CT (fictional) proposes repairing the
masonry façade of a property at 42 Rhine Street. The action
covers repointing of failed mortar joints, replacement of
three cracked lintels, and reattachment of a decorative cornice.

table:columns.name: id
table:columns.description: Globally unique proposal id (kebab-case, 3–63 chars).

table:columns.name: schemaVersion
table:columns.description: Version of the proposed-action JSON Schema the contract was authored against.

table:columns.name: createdAt
table:columns.description: ISO 8601 timestamp with timezone at which the proposal was authored.

table:columns.name: jurisdiction
table:columns.description: Municipality slug (`<country>-<state>-<name>`).

table:columns.name: parcelAuthority
table:columns.description: URI to the authoritative parcel registry.

table:columns.name: parcelId
table:columns.description: Parcel identifier as issued by parcelAuthority.

table:columns.name: authorityRecordVersion
table:columns.description: Version of the parcel-authority snapshot this reference was drawn from.

table:columns.name: authorityRetrievedAt
table:columns.description: When the parcel-authority record was retrieved.

table:columns.name: geometryFormat
table:columns.description: Format of the geometry (geojson | wkt | h3).

table:columns.name: crs
table:columns.description: Coordinate reference system (e.g. `EPSG:4326`).

table:columns.name: snapshotHash
table:columns.description: sha256 of (authorityRecordVersion + retrievedAt + geometryFormat + crs + geometry).

table:columns.name: parcelOwnershipStatus
table:columns.description:
PUBLIC field — sourced from the parcel authority. Separate
from applicant.authorityProof.kind (which is RESTRICTED).

table:columns.name: address
table:columns.description: Public street address.

table:columns.name: activityCode
table:columns.description:
Activity code, validated against
ontology/activity-concept-catalog.v1.0.json. Seeded by the
federal CATEX catalogue (used as a vocabulary source only)
and broadened by a small set of municipal-intake activities.

table:columns.name: activityPreferredLabel
table:columns.description: Cached human-readable label from the catalog (denormalised for offline readers).

table:columns.name: purpose
table:columns.description: Free-text description of the proposed action (≤ 500 chars).

table:columns.name: estimatedCostUsd
table:columns.description: Estimated total cost in USD.

table:columns.name: lifecycleState
table:columns.description:
Current state in the FSM
(draft|submitted|anchored|under_review|approved|rejected|
 amended|superseded|revoked|expired).

table:columns.name: decisionIssuer
table:columns.description:
Authority that issued the most recent municipal decision.
Required iff lifecycleState ∈ {approved, rejected, revoked}.

table:columns.name: decisionAt
table:columns.description: Timestamp of the most recent municipal decision.

table:columns.name: decisionEvidence
table:columns.description: Free-text justification, conditions, or municipal record reference.

table:columns.name: supersedes
table:columns.description: Content hash of the predecessor revision this one replaces.

table:columns.name: revokedAt
table:columns.description: Set iff lifecycleState = revoked.

table:columns.name: anchorContentHash
table:columns.description: SHA-256 of canonicalised bytes of this revision (per the anchor service).

table:columns.name: anchorSubmissionId
table:columns.description: Opaque id returned by the anchor service.

table:columns.name: anchorAnchoredAt
table:columns.description: Timestamp from the anchor service.

table:columns.name: anchorServiceRef
table:columns.description: URI of the anchor service (for re-checking).
